lessons.title: Hearsay Evidentiality: Distinguishing Гэнэ (They Say) vs Сурагтай (Rumored)
lessons.cyrillicTitle: Communicate reported information, relay news, and report unverified gossip without claiming direct personal eyewitness authority.
lessons.primaryPurpose: Introduce the B1 hearsay evidentiality system: 1) Quotative/hearsay particle гэнэ (reporting second-hand information, rumors, or unverified claims: маргааш цас орно гэнэ, тэр их сайн ажилладаг гэнэ), and 2) Inferential hearsay/news particle сурагтай (distant rumor or widespread hearsay: хөдөө өвөлжилт хүндрэх сурагтай, шинэ төсөл эхлэх сурагтай).
lessons.communicativeOutcome: Communicate reported information, relay news, and report unverified gossip without claiming direct personal eyewitness authority.
lessons.audioPurpose: Demonstrate the sentence-final descending intonation of гэнэ and сурагтай.
